AND pdoc.dissassociation_date IS null AND pdoc.stateno = rec.stateno(+) ), query2 AS (SELECT level l FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <=2) ,query3 AS ( SELECT Distinct a.lname_soundex, a.dob_text, case when birth_sex is null and l = 1 then 'M' when birth_sex is null and l != 1 then 'F' when birth_sex is not null then birth_sex end birth_sex, a.stateno, date_of_birth ,cityno , EHARS_STATENO FROM query1 a, query2 where a.lname_soundex is not null AND a.association_date > max_assoc_dt AND a.association_date > file_gen_dt ORDER BY lname_soundex, date_of_birth ) SELECT ROWNUM, a.* FROM query3 a

WITH data AS ( SELECT DISTINCT a.STATENO,To_Char(a.UNFLAG_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY hh:mi:ss AM') UNFLAG_DATE, UNFLAG_COMMENTS, To_Char(a.create_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY hh:mi:ss AM') CREATE_DATE, a.COMMENTS, To_Char(a.generate_date, 'MM/DD/YYYY hh:mi:ss AM') GENERATE_DATE, a.SENT_FILE_NAME , (SELECT Count(*) FROM nyehms_rec_search_sent d WHERE d.sent_file_name = a.sent_file_name AND d.stateno = a.stateno) SENT_COUNT , c.STATE_CD FROM nyehms_flag_record_search a left outer JOIN nyehms_rec_search_sent b ON (b.sent_file_name = a.sent_file_name AND b.stateno = a.stateno) left outer JOIN nyehms_rec_search_return c ON (c.sent_file_name = b.sent_file_name AND c.sent_file_seq = b.sent_file_seq) WHERE a.stateno = #{stateNo} ) SELECT stateno, UNFLAG_DATE, UNFLAG_COMMENTS, sent_file_name, create_date, comments, generate_date, sent_count ,listagg(state_cd, ',') within GROUP (order by stateno) AS state_cd
FROM data GROUP BY stateno, UNFLAG_DATE, UNFLAG_COMMENTS, sent_file_name, create_date, comments, generate_date, sent_count ORDER BY create_date DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO nyehms_flag_record_search a USING ( WITH data AS ( SELECT Distinct s.sent_file_name, s.stateno sent_stateno, FIRST_VALUE(r.stateno IGNORE NULLS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stateno) ret_stateno FROM nyehms_flag_record_search a JOIN nyehms_rec_search_sent s ON s.sent_file_name = a.sent_file_name AND s.stateno = a.stateno and s.sent_file_name = #{fileName} LEFT JOIN nyehms_rec_search_return r ON r.sent_file_name = s.sent_file_name AND s.sent_file_seq = r.sent_file_seq ) SELECT * FROM data WHERE ret_stateno IS NULL ) b ON (b.sent_file_name = a.sent_file_name AND b.sent_stateno = a.stateno) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET unflag_comments = 'No match found' WHERE unflag_date IS NOT NULL
update nyehms_flag_record_search set unflag_comments = 'CDC match' where unflag_comments = 'Waiting for CDC match' and sent_file_name = #{fileName}

MERGE INTO NYEHMS_OWNER.NYEHMS_REC_SEARCH_RETURN out USING ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.rowid row_id , pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pdoc.stateno, A.STATE_CD, A.STATENO ORDER BY pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE DESC) rn FROM NYEHMS_REC_SEARCH_RETURN a, NYEHMS_REC_SEARCH_SENT sent, RAW_ACRF_RIDR_INFO b, RAW_ACRF_DOC c , person_doc_association pdoc WHERE a.sent_file_name = #{fileName} and a.ACRF_DOC_ID is null and a.DISCARDED_DATE is null and a.RIDR_SAME_AS is null and b.ACRF_DOC_ID = c.document_id and c.DOCUMENT_SOURCE in ('A06.18', 'A06.29') and c.document_id = pdoc.document_id and pdoc.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE is null
AND ABS(Trunc(pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE ) - Trunc(SYSDATE)) <= 180
and a.sent_file_name = sent.sent_File_name and a.sent_file_seq = sent.sent_file_Seq and b.STATE_CD = a.STATE_CD and b.STATENO = a.STATENO and pdoc.stateno = PKG_CONSOLIDATION.FN_GIVE_CURRENT_STATENO (sent.STATENO )
) WHERE rn = 1 ) m ON (out.rowid = m.row_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PARENT_DOC_EXISTS = 'Y', PARENT_DOC_CREATE_DT = ASSOCIATION_DATE
